newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas Dagangan gets Islamic financing.
newsitem.headline: Petronas Dagangan gets Islamic financing.

text.p: Petronas Dagangan Bhd said on Thursday it had obtained a 250 million ringgit five-year Islamic financing facility to fund its participation in a multi-product pipeline and distribution terminal project.
The Murabahah Notes Issuance Facility was arranged by Commerce International Merchant Bankers Bhd, a statement from state oil firm Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) said.
The arrangement will allow Petronas Dagangan to raise funds by issuing the notes to 12 participating tender panel members comprising mostly discount houses, it said.
The project is being developed with Shell Malaysia Trading Sdn Bhd.

The facility would also be used to finance the construction of additional service stations under the company's medium-term expansion plans, the statement said. Petronas Dagangan is the retail arm of the national oil company.

The facility, the second Islamic funding secured by Petronas Dagangan, had earlier been assigned a P1 rating by Rating Agency Malaysia (RAM), indicating its low risk rating with regards to timely repayment.
